metadata.title: JA4proxy TLS Security Proxy
metadata.description: This data connector ingests telemetry from JA4proxy — a TLS-aware passthrough security proxy — into Microsoft Sentinel via Azure Monitor Logs (Custom Logs / Log Analytics HTTP Data Collector API). Events are stored in the JA4proxy_CL custom table.
prerequisites: JA4proxy with logging.format: ecs set in config/proxy.yml
Vector shipping agent configured with config/integrations/vector-sentinel.yaml
SENTINEL_WORKSPACE_ID and SENTINEL_SHARED_KEY environment variables set on the proxy host
metadata.author: JA4proxy

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Event timestamp (UTC). Copied from ECS @timestamp field.

columns.name: ja4proxy_action_s
columns.description: Action taken: allowed, blocked, banned, tarpitted, rate_limited, flagged

columns.name: ja4proxy_risk_score_d
columns.description: Composite risk score 0-100 from the JA4proxy RiskScorer

columns.name: source_ip_s
columns.description: Client source IP address (IPv4 or IPv6)

columns.name: RawData
columns.description: Original ECS JSON event as emitted by JA4proxy
